title: Two wallets from one class
objective: Make two objects from the same class, and see that each one keeps its own coins.

body.text: Each new object from a class has its own fields. Two wallets made from the same class start at 0 and change separately. Adding coins to one does not change the other.

body.title: Separate wallets
body.code:
class wallet
    has coins of type number
    construction
        set coins of myself to 0
    can add
        takes number called amount
        increase coins of myself by amount

make a equal to a new wallet
make b equal to a new wallet
add 4 to a
add 6 to b
say coins of a
say coins of b

body.prompt: The second coin amount goes into wallet a instead of b, so the program prints 10 and 0. Make it print 3 and 7.
